name: homepage-craft
description: Generate a beautiful single-file HTML homepage for an open-source project: scans the repo (manifest, README, screenshots, git metadata) and outputs a GitHub-Pages-ready docs/index.html. Detects and orchestrates installed design skills (frontend-design / ui-ux-pro-max / superdesign) for visual quality, falling back to a built-in design baseline when none are present. Optionally auto-deploys to GitHub Pages (commit + push + enable Pages via gh) after asking the user, who also picks the publishing strategy: ship with the main branch + /docs, or isolate on a dedicated gh-pages branch.
